## Understanding data {.title-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Week 4</div>

<div class="concept-line" style="margin-top:1em;">
From recorded values to usable information.
</div>

::: {.notes}
This week is a data-literacy pivot. Students now assume that a study has produced observations; the lecture asks how values become usable information, how data are structured and cleaned, and how visualization guides exploratory analysis.
:::

## From last week to this week {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Retrieval</div>

<div class="dik-flow">
<div class="dik-node model fragment fade-up"><div class="dik-title">Study design</div><div class="dik-sub">how observations are generated</div></div>
<div class="dik-arrow fragment fade-in">→</div>
<div class="dik-node data fragment fade-up"><div class="dik-title">Data</div><div class="dik-sub">recorded observations</div></div>
<div class="dik-arrow fragment fade-in">→</div>
<div class="dik-node know fragment fade-up"><div class="dik-title">Decisions</div><div class="dik-sub">only as credible as the data-generating process</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Careful planning creates data we can trust. Now we ask how to understand those data.</div>
:::

## Visual pattern → hypothesis → evidence {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">A bridge back to causality: Pattern recognition is the beginning, not the conclusion</div>

<div class="dik-flow">
<div class="dik-node data fragment fade-up"><div class="dik-title">Visual pattern</div><div class="dik-sub">something appears structured</div></div>
<div class="dik-arrow fragment fade-in">→</div>
<div class="dik-node info fragment fade-up"><div class="dik-title">Hypothesis</div><div class="dik-sub">a possible explanation</div></div>
<div class="dik-arrow fragment fade-in">→</div>
<div class="dik-node know fragment fade-up"><div class="dik-title">Evidence</div><div class="dik-sub">study design + analysis test the explanation</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Visualization can generate questions. It does not, by itself, prove causes.</div>
:::

## Data are recorded values {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Without context, values are disconnected from the world</div>

<div class="w4-grid-4">
<div class="w4-card observed-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">37.8</div><div class="w4-card-sub">value only</div></div>

<div class="w4-card observed-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">F</div><div class="w4-card-sub">symbol only</div></div>
<div class="w4-card observed-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Stage 2</div><div class="w4-card-sub">label only</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">A number becomes useful only when we know what it represents.</div>
:::

<div class="eyebrow">Same values, now connected to meaning</div>

<div class="w4-grid-4">

<div class="eyebrow">Three levels of use</div>

<div class="dik-flow">
<div class="dik-node data fragment fade-up"><div class="dik-title">Data</div><div class="dik-img-wrap"><img src="figures/data.jpg" alt="data"></div><div class="dik-sub">recorded values, symbols or measurements</div></div>

<div class="dik-arrow fragment fade-in">→</div>

</div>

## Information as surprise {.math-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">A short information-theory side-track</div>

<div class="definition-box large-definition">
$$
I(x)=-\log_2 \mathbb{P}(x)
$$
</div>

<div class="info-card-row">
<div class="info-card fragment fade-up"><div class="p">$P(x)=1$</div><div class="bits">0 bits</div></div>
<div class="info-card fragment fade-up"><div class="p">$P(x)=1/2$</div><div class="bits">1 bit</div></div>
<div class="info-card fragment fade-up"><div class="p">$P(x)=1/8$</div><div class="bits">3 bits</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Rare events are more surprising, so observing them carries more information.</div>
:::

## Try it: probability and surprise {.exercise-slide}

<div class="try-label">Interactive concept slide</div>

<div class="info-widget" id="surpriseWidget">
<div class="w4-control-row">

<div class="w4-output"><span>probability</span><br><strong id="surprisePValue">0.50</strong></div>

</div>
<div class="info-bar-wrap"><div id="surpriseBar" class="info-bar"></div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">As probability goes down, surprise goes up.</div>
:::

## Entropy is expected surprise {.math-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Average information content</div>

<div class="definition-box large-definition">
$$
H(X)=-\sum_i \mathbb{P}(x_i)\log_2 \mathbb{P}(x_i)
$$
</div>

<div class="entropy-compare">
<div class="entropy-source fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Predictable source</div><div class="entropy-stream">AAAAAAAAABAAAAAA</div><div class="entropy-value">low entropy</div></div>
<div class="entropy-source fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Less predictable source</div><div class="entropy-stream">ABBAABAABBABBAAB</div><div class="entropy-value">higher entropy</div></div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  function applyColorize() {
    const colorizeStream = (str) => {
      return str
        .replace(/A/g, '<span class="char-a">A</span>')
        .replace(/B/g, '<span class="char-b">B</span>');
    };
    document.querySelectorAll('.entropy-stream').forEach((el) => {
      // Avoid re-running if already processed
      if (!el.dataset.colorized) {
        el.innerHTML = colorizeStream(el.textContent.trim());
        el.dataset.colorized = "true";
      }
    });
  }

  // Execute immediately if DOM elements exist
  applyColorize();

  // Also hook into Reveal if available and not yet ready
  if (window.Reveal && typeof Reveal.on === 'function') {
    Reveal.on('ready', applyColorize);
    Reveal.on('slidechanged', applyColorize);
  }
})();
</script>

## Entropy and randomness {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Shared mathematics across information and physical states</div>

<div class="w4-grid-2">
<div class="w4-card probability-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Shannon entropy</div><div class="w4-card-sub">uncertainty over possible messages or symbols</div><div class="w4-card-eq">high entropy → hard to predict</div></div>
<div class="w4-card model-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Statistical-mechanical entropy</div><div class="w4-card-sub">uncertainty over possible microstates</div><div class="w4-card-eq">shared mathematical structure</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Both quantify uncertainty over possible states.</div>
:::

<div class="timeline">
  <div class="timeline-step fragment fade-up">
  <div class="label">Claude Elwood Shannon</div>
  <img src="figures/Shannon.jpg" alt="Claude Shannon" class="step-image">
  </div>
</div>

## Types of variables {.section-break}

<div class="section-kicker">Part II</div>

<div class="section-title">Types of variables</div>

<div class="section-subtitle">We now see the different data types and their characteristics.</div>

## First question: what kind of variable is it? {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Data types determine meaningful summaries and plots</div>

<div class="var-tree">
<div class="var-branch cat fragment fade-up">
<div class="var-branch-title">Categorical</div>
<div class="var-leaves"><div class="var-leaf"><strong>Nominal</strong><br>names, no order</div><div class="var-leaf"><strong>Ordinal</strong><br>ordered categories</div></div>
</div>
<div class="var-branch num fragment fade-up">
<div class="var-branch-title">Numerical</div>
<div class="var-leaves"><div class="var-leaf"><strong>Interval</strong><br>differences meaningful</div><div class="var-leaf"><strong>Ratio</strong><br>ratios meaningful</div></div>
</div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">The data type tells us what operations make sense.</div>
:::

## Nominal and ordinal examples {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Categorical variables</div>

<div class="w4-grid-2">
<div class="w4-card observed-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Nominal</div><div class="w4-card-sub">formulation type · sex · genotype · adverse-event category</div><div class="w4-card-eq">no intrinsic order</div></div>
<div class="w4-card observed-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Ordinal</div><div class="w4-card-sub">disease stage · toxicity grade · response category · pain scale</div><div class="w4-card-eq">ordered categories</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Nominal categories of "A", "B", "0" blood group have no inherent order or distance.</div>
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Ordinal categories of "severe", "normal", "moderate" still have no inherent distance (difference and sum are not meaningful), but there is inherent order.</div>
:::

## Interval and ratio examples {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Numerical variables</div>

<div class="w4-grid-2">
<div class="w4-card model-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Interval</div><div class="w4-card-sub">temperature in °C · calendar year</div><div class="w4-card-eq">differences meaningful</div></div>
<div class="w4-card model-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Ratio</div><div class="w4-card-sub">mass · concentration · dose · time · Kelvin temperature</div><div class="w4-card-eq">differences and ratios meaningful</div><div class="w4-card-eq">absolute zero exists</div></div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">A temperature of 20 °C is not “twice as hot” as 10 °C; a 20 mg dose is twice a 10 mg dose.</div>
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Note how Celsius scale has no absolute zero point (it can be positive and negative), while Kelvin has an absolute zero.</div>
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">But not every value that can be negative is automatically interval: for electric charge the negative does not signify magnitude, but rather direction, so it is still ratio.</div>
:::

## Which summaries make sense? {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">A bridge back to Week 3</div>

<div class="summary-sense-table fragment fade-up" style="font-size: 4rem;">
<div class="head">Variable type</div><div class="head">Frequency</div><div class="head">Mode</div><div class="head">Median</div><div class="head">Mean</div>
<div class="head">Nominal</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="no">—</div><div class="no">—</div>
<div class="head">Ordinal</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="no">usually no</div>
<div class="head">Numerical</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="yes">✓</div><div class="yes">✓</div>
</div>

## Wide format → Long format {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Humans often like reading repeated measurements side-by-side → Long format often makes grouping and plotting easier</div>

<div class="format-demo">
<div class="mini-data-table format-table-wide fragment fade-up">
<div class="head">patient</div><div class="head">day1</div><div class="head">day2</div><div class="head">day3</div>
<div>P01</div><div>120</div><div>124</div><div>122</div>
<div>P02</div><div>142</div><div>139</div><div>137</div>
</div>
<div class="format-arrow fragment fade-in">→</div>
<div class="mini-data-table format-table-long fragment fade-up">
<div class="head">patient</div><div class="head">day</div><div class="head">bp_mmHg</div>
<div>P01</div><div>1</div><div>120</div><div>P01</div><div>2</div><div>124</div><div>P01</div><div>3</div><div>122</div><div>P02</div><div>1</div><div>142</div><div>P02</div><div>2</div><div>139</div><div>P02</div><div>3</div><div>137</div>
</div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
<div class="concept-line">Wide format keeps multiple measurement occasions in separate columns.</div>
:::

## Transformation creates derived variables {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">Raw variables can create new variables</div>

<div class="transform-equation fragment fade-up">
<div class="transform-card">weight = 72 kg</div>
<div class="transform-card">height = 1.78 m</div>
<div class="transform-arrow">→</div>
<div class="transform-card estimate">BMI = 22.7</div>
</div>

<div class="definition-box fragment fade-up">
$$
BMI=\frac{\mathrm{weight}_{kg}}{\mathrm{height}_m^2}
$$
</div>

## Transformation changes representation {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">The patient does not change; the data representation changes</div>

<div class="w4-grid-4">
<div class="w4-card observed-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Units</div><div class="w4-card-sub">kg → g</div></div>
<div class="w4-card model-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Temperature scale</div><div class="w4-card-sub">°C → K</div></div>
<div class="w4-card probability-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Log scale</div><div class="w4-card-sub">concentration → log concentration</div></div>
<div class="w4-card estimate-border fragment fade-up"><div class="w4-card-title">Derived variable</div><div class="w4-card-sub">weight + height → BMI</div></div>
</div>

## Handling missing values {.concept-slide}

<div class="eyebrow">No method is automatically safe</div>

<div class="cleaning-cards">
  <!-- Card 1: Delete Rows -->
  <div class="cleaning-card fragment fade-up">
  <div class="cleaning-title">Delete rows</div>
  <div class="cleaning-img-wrap">
  <img src="figures/clean-delete-rows.jpg" alt="Delete rows illustration">
  </div>
  <div class="cleaning-sub">simple, but can discard information or bias results</div>
  </div>
  <!-- Card 2: Simple Imputation -->
  <div class="cleaning-card fragment fade-up">
  <div class="cleaning-title">Simple imputation</div>
  <div class="cleaning-img-wrap">
  <img src="figures/clean-simple-imputation.jpg" alt="Mean median mode imputation illustration">
  </div>
  <div class="cleaning-sub">mean · median · mode</div>
  </div>
  <!-- Card 3: Model-based -->
  <div class="cleaning-card fragment fade-up">
  <div class="cleaning-title">Similarity/model-based</div>
  <div class="cleaning-img-wrap">
  <img src="figures/clean-model-imputation.jpg" alt="Model based imputation illustration">
  </div>
  <div class="cleaning-sub">use related variables or similar records</div>
  </div>
  <!-- Card 4: Carry Forward -->
  <div class="cleaning-card fragment fade-up">
  <div class="cleaning-title">Carry forward</div>
  <div class="cleaning-img-wrap">
  <img src="figures/clean-locf.jpg" alt="Last observation carried forward illustration">
  </div>
  <div class="cleaning-sub">useful for time-series data</div>
  </div>
</div>

::: {.fragment .fade-up}

## What did we learn? {.concept-slide}

<div class="pipeline-step fragment fade-up">Good data begin with a credible data-generating process.</div>
<div class="pipeline-step fragment fade-up">Structure makes data usable: rows, columns, variables and values.</div>

(function(){

const patients = [

{id:'P18', sex:'M', stage:3, diabetes:true, height:190, bp:170, temp:38.5}
];

function bpStatus(bp){ if(bp < 120) return 'low'; if(bp <= 139) return 'normal'; return 'high'; }
function mean(a){ return a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/a.length; }
function sd(a){ const m=mean(a); return Math.sqrt(a.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x-m)**2,0)/(a.length-1)); }
function median(a){ const b=[...a].sort((x,y)=>x-y); const n=b.length; return n%2?b[(n-1)/2]:(b[n/2-1]+b[n/2])/2; }

function pathLine(points){ return points.map((p,i)=>`${i?'L':'M'} ${p[0].toFixed(1)} ${p[1].toFixed(1)}`).join(' '); }
function clearSvg(svg){ if(svg) svg.innerHTML=''; }
function makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,right,top){ return `<line x1="${left}" y1="${bottom}" x2="${W-right}" y2="${bottom}" class="plot-axis"/><line x1="${left}" y1="${top}" x2="${left}" y2="${bottom}" class="plot-axis"/>`; }

function drawOutbreak(svgId, detailed=true){
 const svg=document.getElementById(svgId); if(!svg) return;
 const data=[21,24,26,31,48,52,55,41,38,72,76,80,63,58,51,98,103,110,87,79,70,65,60,57,89,93,96,78,66,55,51,44,38,36,32,34,46,49,43,35,31,29,24,22,25,28,32,30,26,24];
 const W=700,H=360,left=50,right=28,top=24,bottom=305; const maxY=120; const mapX=i=>left+i/(data.length-1)*(W-left-right); const mapY=y=>bottom-y/maxY*(bottom-top);
 let html=makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,right,top);
 if(detailed){ html += `<rect x="${mapX(28)}" y="${top}" width="${mapX(49)-mapX(28)}" height="${bottom-top}" class="outbreak-band"/><line x1="${mapX(28)}" y1="${top}" x2="${mapX(28)}" y2="${bottom}" class="outbreak-vax"/><text x="${mapX(28)+6}" y="${top+18}" class="outbreak-vax-label">marked rollout</text>`; }
 html += `<path d="${pathLine(data.map((y,i)=>[mapX(i),mapY(y)]))}" class="outbreak-line"/>`;
 [0,10,20,30,40,49].forEach(i=>{ html += `<text x="${mapX(i)}" y="${bottom+20}" text-anchor="middle" class="outbreak-note">${i}</text>`; });
 html += `<text x="${left+6}" y="${top+15}" class="outbreak-note">synthetic cases</text>`;
 if(detailed){ html += `<text x="${mapX(11)}" y="${mapY(100)-10}" class="outbreak-note">larger spikes</text><text x="${mapX(38)}" y="${mapY(50)-10}" class="outbreak-note">smaller later spikes</text>`; }
 svg.innerHTML=html;
 const table=document.getElementById('outbreakNumbers'); if(table && svgId==='outbreakSvg'){ table.innerHTML=data.slice(0,35).map(x=>`<span>${x}</span>`).join(''); }
}

function updateSurprise(){ const p=Number(document.getElementById('surpriseP')?.value||0.5); const bits=-Math.log2(p); const pv=document.getElementById('surprisePValue'), bv=document.getElementById('surpriseBits'), bar=document.getElementById('surpriseBar'); if(pv) pv.textContent=p.toFixed(2); if(bv) bv.textContent=bits.toFixed(2)+' bits'; if(bar) bar.style.width=Math.min(100,bits/6*100)+'%'; }

const quizItems=[
 {name:'blood group', answer:'nominal', why:'Blood group names have no natural numerical order.'},
 {name:'disease stage', answer:'ordinal', why:'Stages are ordered categories.'},
 {name:'tablet mass', answer:'ratio', why:'Mass has a meaningful zero and ratios make sense.'},
 {name:'temperature in °C', answer:'interval', why:'Differences make sense; ratios do not.'},
 {name:'treatment arm', answer:'nominal', why:'Treatment labels are categories.'}
];
let quizIndex=0;
function initVarQuiz(){ const box=document.getElementById('varQuiz'); if(!box) return; const item=document.getElementById('varQuizItem'); const fb=document.getElementById('varQuizFeedback'); const buttons=box.querySelectorAll('button'); function show(){ item.textContent=quizItems[quizIndex].name; fb.textContent='Choose the best type.'; fb.className='var-feedback'; } buttons.forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ const q=quizItems[quizIndex]; const ok=btn.dataset.answer===q.answer; fb.textContent=(ok?'Correct. ':'Not quite. ')+q.why; fb.className='var-feedback '+(ok?'good':'bad'); if(ok){ setTimeout(()=>{ quizIndex=(quizIndex+1)%quizItems.length; show(); },1500); } })); show(); }

function initQuery(){ const w=document.getElementById('queryWidget'); if(!w) return; const ids=['qDiabetes','qSex','qBpStatus','qStage','qHeight','qLogic']; ids.forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('input',renderQuery)); renderQuery(); }
function renderQuery(){ const dia=document.getElementById('qDiabetes').value, sex=document.getElementById('qSex').value, bp=document.getElementById('qBpStatus').value, stage=document.getElementById('qStage').value, h=Number(document.getElementById('qHeight').value), logic=document.getElementById('qLogic').value; document.getElementById('qHeightValue').textContent = h;
 const filters=[p=> dia==='any'||String(p.diabetes)===dia, p=> sex==='any'||p.sex===sex, p=> bp==='any'||bpStatus(p.bp)===bp, p=> stage==='any'||String(p.stage)===stage, p=> p.height>=h];
 const active=[dia!=='any', sex!=='any', bp!=='any', stage!=='any', h>150];
 let out=patients.filter(p=>{ const results=filters.map(f=>f(p)); if(!active.some(Boolean)) return true; return logic==='and'?results.every((r,i)=>!active[i]||r):results.some((r,i)=>active[i]&&r); });
 document.getElementById('qCount').textContent=out.length; const tbl=document.getElementById('qTable'); let html='<div class="head">ID</div><div class="head">sex</div><div class="head">stage</div><div class="head">diabetes</div><div class="head">height</div><div class="head">BP</div><div class="head">status</div>'; out.slice(0,6).forEach(p=>{ html+=`<div>${p.id}</div><div>${p.sex}</div><div>${p.stage}</div><div>${p.diabetes}</div><div>${p.height}</div><div>${p.bp}</div><div>${bpStatus(p.bp)}</div>`; }); tbl.innerHTML=html; }

function barSvg(svgId, values, labels, colors){ const svg=document.getElementById(svgId); if(!svg) return; const W=500,H=300,left=55,right=30,top=20,bottom=245; const max=Math.max(...values)*1.15; let html=makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,right,top); values.forEach((v,i)=>{ const bw=80; const gap=(W-left-right-values.length*bw)/(values.length+1); const x=left+gap+i*(bw+gap); const y=bottom-v/max*(bottom-top); html += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${bw}" height="${bottom-y}" class="${colors?.[i]||'plot-bar'}"/><text x="${x+bw/2}" y="${bottom+18}" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">${labels[i]}</text><text x="${x+bw/2}" y="${y-6}" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">${v}</text>`; }); svg.innerHTML=html; }
function drawOneCat(){ const f=patients.filter(p=>p.sex==='F').length, m=patients.length-f; barSvg('plotOneCat',[f,m],['F','M'],['plot-bar','plot-bar2']); }
function drawTwoCat(){ const svg=document.getElementById('plotTwoCat'); if(!svg) return; const W=500,H=300,left=60,bottom=245,top=25; let html=makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,30,top); const sexes=['F','M'], stages=[1,2,3], cols=['#1f6feb','#7b4ab5','#c65d09']; sexes.forEach((sex,i)=>{ let x=150+i*170; let y=bottom; stages.forEach((st,j)=>{ const count=patients.filter(p=>p.sex===sex&&p.stage===st).length; const h=count/9*(bottom-top); html += `<rect x="${x}" y="${y-h}" width="80" height="${h}" fill="${cols[j]}" opacity=".72"/>`; y-=h; }); html += `<text x="${x+40}" y="${bottom+18}" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">${sex}</text>`; }); svg.innerHTML=html; }
function drawHistogram(svgId, vals){ const svg=document.getElementById(svgId); if(!svg)return; const W=500,H=300,left=55,bottom=245,top=25,right=30; const min=Math.min(...vals), max=Math.max(...vals), bins=5; const counts=Array(bins).fill(0); vals.forEach(v=>{ let idx=Math.min(bins-1,Math.floor((v-min)/(max-min+1e-9)*bins)); counts[idx]++; }); let html=makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,right,top); const maxC=Math.max(...counts); const bw=(W-left-right)/bins; counts.forEach((c,i)=>{ const x=left+i*bw+3; const h=c/maxC*(bottom-top); html+=`<rect x="${x}" y="${bottom-h}" width="${bw-6}" height="${h}" class="plot-bar"/>`; }); // box below
 const med=median(vals), q1=median(vals.filter(v=>v<=med)), q3=median(vals.filter(v=>v>=med)); const mapX=v=>left+(v-min)/(max-min)*(W-left-right); html+=`<line x1="${mapX(min)}" y1="270" x2="${mapX(max)}" y2="270" class="plot-axis"/><rect x="${mapX(q1)}" y="260" width="${mapX(q3)-mapX(q1)}" height="20" class="plot-box"/><line x1="${mapX(med)}" y1="258" x2="${mapX(med)}" y2="282" class="plot-median"/>`; svg.innerHTML=html; }
function drawScatter(svgId, encode=false){ const svg=document.getElementById(svgId); if(!svg)return; const W=700,H=320,left=55,bottom=270,top=25,right=30; const xs=patients.map(p=>p.bp), ys=patients.map(p=>p.temp); const xMin=105,xMax=175,yMin=36.4,yMax=38.7; const mapX=x=>left+(x-xMin)/(xMax-xMin)*(W-left-right); const mapY=y=>bottom-(y-yMin)/(yMax-yMin)*(bottom-top); let html=makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,right,top); patients.forEach(p=>{ const col=p.sex==='F'?'#1f6feb':'#c65d09'; const shape=p.stage===1?'circle':p.stage===2?'rect':'triangle'; const x=mapX(p.bp), y=mapY(p.temp); if(!encode || shape==='circle') html += `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="5" fill="${encode?col:'#1f6feb'}" opacity=".78"/>`; else if(shape==='rect') html += `<rect x="${x-5}" y="${y-5}" width="10" height="10" fill="${col}" opacity=".78"/>`; else html += `<polygon points="${x},${y-6} ${x-6},${y+6} ${x+6},${y+6}" fill="${col}" opacity=".78"/>`; }); html += `<text x="${W/2}" y="305" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">bp_mmHg</text><text x="18" y="150" transform="rotate(-90 18 150)" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">bodyT_C</text>`; svg.innerHTML=html; }
function drawBoxplot(svgId, by='sex'){ const svg=document.getElementById(svgId); if(!svg)return; const W=700,H=320,left=55,bottom=270,top=25; const groups=by==='sex'?['F','M']:[1,2,3]; const valsBy=g=>patients.filter(p=>by==='sex'?p.sex===g:p.stage===g).map(p=>p.bp); const yMin=105,yMax=175; const mapY=y=>bottom-(y-yMin)/(yMax-yMin)*(bottom-top); let html=makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,30,top); groups.forEach((g,i)=>{ const vals=valsBy(g).sort((a,b)=>a-b); const med=median(vals), q1=median(vals.filter(v=>v<=med)), q3=median(vals.filter(v=>v>=med)), mn=vals[0], mx=vals[vals.length-1]; const x=150+i*(400/(groups.length-1||1)); html+=`<line x1="${x}" y1="${mapY(mn)}" x2="${x}" y2="${mapY(mx)}" class="plot-axis"/><rect x="${x-35}" y="${mapY(q3)}" width="70" height="${mapY(q1)-mapY(q3)}" class="plot-box"/><line x1="${x-38}" y1="${mapY(med)}" x2="${x+38}" y2="${mapY(med)}" class="plot-median"/><text x="${x}" y="${bottom+18}" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">${g}</text>`; vals.forEach((v,j)=>{html+=`<circle cx="${x-18+j*7}" cy="${mapY(v)}" r="3" class="plot-dot"/>`;}); }); svg.innerHTML=html; }
function drawHeatmap(){ const svg=document.getElementById('plotHeatmap'); if(!svg)return; const W=500,H=300,left=90,top=40,cell=55; let html=''; ['F','M'].forEach((sex,i)=>{ [1,2,3].forEach((st,j)=>{ const vals=patients.filter(p=>p.sex===sex&&p.stage===st).map(p=>p.bp); const m=mean(vals); const intensity=(m-110)/60; html+=`<rect x="${left+j*cell}" y="${top+i*cell}" width="${cell}" height="${cell}" fill="rgba(123,74,181,${0.15+intensity*.65})"/><text x="${left+j*cell+cell/2}" y="${top+i*cell+cell/2+4}" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">${m.toFixed(0)}</text>`; }); html+=`<text x="${left-15}" y="${top+i*cell+cell/2+4}" text-anchor="end" class="plot-label">${sex}</text>`; }); [1,2,3].forEach((st,j)=>html+=`<text x="${left+j*cell+cell/2}" y="${top-10}" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">stage ${st}</text>`); svg.innerHTML=html; }
function drawVizStatic(){ drawOneCat(); drawTwoCat(); drawHistogram('plotOneNum', patients.map(p=>p.bp)); drawScatter('plotTwoNum'); drawBoxplot('plotCatNum','sex'); drawBoxplot('plotTwoCatNumBox','stage'); drawHeatmap(); drawScatter('plotEncodedScatter',true); drawTrap(); }
function drawTrap(){ barSvg('trapZeroAxis',[88,92],['A','B'],['plot-bar','plot-bar2']); const svg=document.getElementById('trapTruncatedAxis'); if(!svg)return; const W=500,H=300,left=55,bottom=245,top=30,right=30; let html=makeAxis(svg,W,H,left,bottom,right,top); [88,92].forEach((v,i)=>{ const x=145+i*140; const y=bottom-(v-85)/10*(bottom-top); html+=`<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="90" height="${bottom-y}" class="${i?'plot-bar2':'plot-bar'}"/><text x="${x+45}" y="${bottom+18}" text-anchor="middle" class="plot-label">${i?'B':'A'}</text>`; }); svg.innerHTML=html; }

function initVizLab() {
  const lab = document.getElementById("vizLab");
  if (!lab) return;
  lab.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(inp => {
    inp.addEventListener("change", renderVizLab);
  });
  renderVizLab();
}

function renderVizLab() {
  const selected = [
    ...document.querySelectorAll("#vizLab input:checked")
  ].map(x => x.value);
  const summary = document.getElementById("vizLabSummary");
  const image = document.getElementById("vizLabImage");
  if (!summary || !image) return;
  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Nothing selected
     ------------------------------------------------------- */
  if (selected.length === 0) {
    summary.innerHTML =
      "Select one or more variables.";
    image.removeAttribute("src");
    image.style.display = "none";
    return;
  }
  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Variable types
     ------------------------------------------------------- */
  const cats =
    selected.filter(v =>
      ["sex", "stage"].includes(v)
    );
  const nums =
    selected.filter(v =>
      ["bp", "temp"].includes(v)
    );
  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Suggested visualization
     ------------------------------------------------------- */
  let suggestion = "";
  if (
    selected.length === 1 &&
    cats.length === 1
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "frequency table + bar plot";
  } else if (
    selected.length === 1 &&
    nums.length === 1
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "histogram + boxplot";
  } else if (
    cats.length === 2 &&
    nums.length === 0
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "contingency table + stacked bar plot";
  } else if (
    nums.length === 2 &&
    cats.length === 0
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "scatter plot + marginal distributions";
  } else if (
    nums.length === 1 &&
    cats.length === 1
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "grouped boxplots";
  } else if (
    nums.length === 1 &&
    cats.length === 2
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "faceted boxplots + heatmap";
  } else if (
    nums.length === 2 &&
    cats.length === 1
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "scatter plot with categorical encoding";
  } else if (
    nums.length === 2 &&
    cats.length === 2
  ) {
    suggestion =
      "scatter plot with color / size encoding";
  }
  summary.innerHTML = `
    <strong>Selected:</strong><br>
    ${selected.join(", ")}
    <br><br>
    <strong>Types:</strong><br>
    ${cats.length} categorical,
    ${nums.length} numerical
    <br><br>
    <strong>Suggested:</strong><br>
    ${suggestion}
  `;
  /* -------------------------------------------------------
     Choose pre-rendered ggplot SVG
     ------------------------------------------------------- */
  /*
   * Always use the same ordering for filenames:
   * sex → stage → bp → temp
   */
  const order = [
    "sex",
    "stage",
    "bp",
    "temp"
  ];
  const ordered =
    order.filter(v =>
      selected.includes(v)
    );
  const filename = `figures/viz_${ordered.join("_")}.svg`;
  image.src = filename;
  image.style.display = "block";
  image.alt = `Visualization of ${ordered.join(", ")}`;
}

function initMC(){ document.querySelectorAll('.mc-widget').forEach(w=>{ const fb=w.querySelector('.mc-feedback'); w.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ const ok=b.dataset.correct==='true'; fb.textContent=ok?'Correct.':'Not quite — reconsider the variable type and question.'; fb.className='mc-feedback '+(ok?'good':'bad'); })); }); }

function init(){ drawOutbreak('outbreakSvg'); updateSurprise(); document.getElementById('surpriseP')?.addEventListener('input',updateSurprise); initVarQuiz(); initQuery(); drawVizStatic(); initVizLab(); initMC(); }
window.addEventListener('load',init); if(window.Reveal){ Reveal.on('ready',init); Reveal.on('slidechanged',init); Reveal.on('fragmentshown',init); } init();
})();
</script>
